title: Chapter 1185
text:
Han Xiao thought that he was a person who convinced people with (material) logic. Under his explanation (threat), these armed organizations that were following behind to drink the leftovers willingly (and helplessly) retreated from the battle zone and changed their target.

A few days later, the Black Star Corps was the only attacking force left in the Modo Civilization's defense line in the Ferdinand Battle Zone.

Black Star did not hide his arrival at the frontline. The Modo expeditionary army had already received the news and was on high alert. Although the comrades of the Black Star Corps had all retreated, Black Star's arrival raised the Modo expeditionary army's alertness to a higher level than before. Black Star alone was equivalent to thousands of soldiers.

Two days later, the Modo expeditionary army noticed the movements of the Black Star Corps. The other party temporarily recalled the troops that were attacking the other lines of defense, gathered in a large scale, and marched toward one of the lines of defense as if they were about to launch an all-out attack. The leader was Black Star himself.

The Modo expeditionary army immediately responded, mobilizing a large number of troops to reinforce this part of the line of defense.

…

The enormous fleet crossed the galaxy, dragging dense streams of light behind it. After sailing for a while, the line of defense set up by the Modo expeditionary army appeared in front of them. It was like a long dragon made of battleships, armed fortresses, and large mechanical suits, extending all the way to the horizon.

Five celestial bodies were transported over, forming a defensive formation around each other.

The two enormous armies were facing each other across the boundless galaxy, and the two armies were facing each other.

In the command room of the Black Star Corps' flagship, Ames observed the battlefield view, shook her head, and said, "They don't have any Beyond Grade As, and they still want to fight head-on. Is Modo planning to sacrifice their entire fleet?"

"They don't have a choice. If they don't use this stupid method, they can only sit back and watch us invade." Han Xiao smiled.

The only Beyond Grade As who were personally involved in the battle were himself and Ames. Although Modo had Beyond Grade As, they were not willing to expose their identities, and they were restricted by the association, so it was difficult for them to find an excuse to join in. Modo could not make bricks without straw. If they wanted to stop the two Beyond Grade As, they could only fight them head-on with their fleet.

In a battlefield of this level, the existence of Beyond Grade As was of strategic importance. If there were no Beyond Grade As to contend against each other, they could only fill in the gaps with fleets. Even if they could stop the Beyond Grade As for now, it would be difficult to kill them.

No matter how high the production rate was, the speed at which the soldiers were regenerating could not be compared to the speed at which a Beyond Grade A recovered their energy. After repeating this a few times, they would suffer heavy losses. This was a bottomless pit, so all the advanced civilizations wanted to fight for a Beyond Grade A Super.

In high intensity battlefields, the importance of Beyond Grade As would decrease. However, not all wars would require the use of strategic weapons of mass destruction. In the normal intensity Flickering War, Beyond Grade As were more than enough to lead to victory.

At this moment, the fleet commander Herlous said, "Army Commander, the troops have arrived at the target location. Please give us the next step."

Han Xiao waved his hand. "There's no need to stare at them. Just fight."

The order was passed down layer by layer and quickly spread to the entire army.

The next moment, the Black Star Corps launched an attack. It was as if billions of stars suddenly lit up in the dark universe, all of which were the light of psionic cannons.

The light beams that were so bright that they were almost pale poured down like a storm, hitting the protective shield of the Modo Civilization's base and the shields of the spaceships, creating large amounts of electric arcs like splashing water. The combined shield of the Modo expeditionary army's fleets flashed. The energy reserves of the shields of many spaceships in the formation suddenly dropped below the warning line, and they started to sound alarms.

The Modo expeditionary army immediately counterattacked. The assault fleets, assault fleets, and battleships of both sides were activated, charging toward each other and tearing at each other. A horrifying battlefield was formed in no time.

The two sides were enemies with no room for compromise. There was no room for words; they fought as soon as they saw each other. The war broke out immediately!

Ames glanced back. Seeing Han Xiao nod, she strode out of the hatch, turned into a meteor, and charged into the battlefield herself.

The majestic force field condensed into countless dragon pythons, rolling in the enemy's fleet. Pulling, pulling, tearing, vibrating, and other forces worked at the same time. The enemy spaceships were shattered into balls of twisted metal by her force field, and their formation was messed up. Her Esper Ability was known for being all-rounded. She was good at large area AOE attacks, which was very practical in a galactic battlefield.

Han Xiao did not stay idle. He snapped his fingers, and groups of mechanical soldiers walked out of the secondary dimensional army box and entered the battlefield.

The large-scale mechanical army instantly gave the enemy an overwhelming advantage. A ten-man team of soldiers could easily tear apart a Modo heavy battleship. Meanwhile, there were at least three million mechanical soldiers on the battlefield, and the number was still increasing.

The Mechanical Deity was powerful in a one-on-one battle, but the Mech Legion was still more efficient when dealing with large-scale enemies.

As a peak Beyond Grade A and a Mechanic who specialized in warfare, taking action personally on a battlefield of this level was like crushing noobs. Normally, Han Xiao might have saved some energy, but he had no intention of going easy on Modo.

The two sides fought fiercely. The troops of the Modo faction were extremely passive and suffered heavy losses. Their troops were vaporized one after another. Every now and then, there would be agent organizations trying to escape from the battlefield, but most of them were targeted by the wandering mechanical army and blown into pieces.

On the battlefield, the Galactic Business Alliance, Northern Battlefront, 5C Alliance, Plateau Eagle, and the other guild alliances that were on the Supercluster side were hiding everywhere. They did not have any confidence like before and only wanted to survive.

"Luckily, we didn't bring all of our forces this time." The leader of the Northern Battlefront, Fire of North Sea, had a face full of fear.

"If I knew this would happen, I wouldn't have ignored the transfer order." The leader of Plateau Eagle had a troubled expression.

"Now is not the time to celebrate. The Modo expeditionary army won't be able to hold this line of defense. Let's think about how to protect the troops we have. Although it's not a lot, it still hurts my heart," the president of the Galactic Business Alliance said helplessly.

Due to the attack of the Black Star Corps, the national war between the players was currently mainly concentrated in the Ferdinand Battlefront. The player alliances of the Supercluster side were temporarily under the command of the Modo Civilization.

When they learned that the Black Star Corps was about to launch an all-out attack, these important Immortal allies also received the transfer order from Modo to guard this line of defense together.

These guild alliances were not stupid. They knew that Black Star was coming from the forums, so they were careful and only brought a small number of troops to participate in the battle.

Reality proved that this choice was wise. The other side had two Beyond Grade As, and Modo had none. Their chances of winning were less than one percent. If these guild alliances had brought all of their assets over, they would all be dead by now.

Although the main focus of the national war was the players, fleets and equipment were equally important. The guild alliances of the Supercluster side had accumulated a lot of capital, but if they all died, they would not be able to fight the national war anymore. They would definitely be trampled on by the players of the Black Star Corps.

Speaking of which, these guild alliances also felt very helpless.

Our national war was going well, but the Black Star Corps let their boss out again. Isn't this bullying?

If Black Star likes to fight in person so much, how are we going to fight against the army players?

This feeling was like two children fighting, but the adults in the other party's family joined in. Unreasonable!

During this period of time, the guild alliances had been fighting in the free competition zone, and none of the NPC organizations they met were not afraid of them, the Cancer of the Universe. However, the guild alliances also knew that in front of a super boss like Black Star, they, the Cancer of the Universe, were also a weak group. They would not be able to survive even if they revived a few times.

With the help of two Beyond Grade As, the battle became one-sided. Very soon, a gap was created in the defense line. The reinforcements could not even arrive in time, and the Modo garrison in this defense line showed signs of retreating.

Han Xiao observed the situation, looked at the gap created in the defense line, and said, "It's about time. We can go in now."

As he spoke, he looked back at Herlous.

"I'll leave a Lord's Avatar to guard the fleet and some mechanical troops for you. Take the army and don't attack the center of Modo. Continue to attack the various outer defense lines and focus on killing the enemy's forces."

"Understood." Herlous nodded with a serious expression. After many years of leading troops, he was still quite dignified when he was not addicted to playing cards. He said, "You and Her Excellency Dragon Emperor are going to attack the Modo expeditionary army's base alone. You must be careful."

"It's not me who should be careful, it's them."

Han Xiao smiled, flew out of the battleship, and pulled Ames, who had been fighting the entire time. Surrounded by the mechanical army, they quickly passed through the dense artillery fire and crossed the battlefield.

The Modo expeditionary army was defeated again and again, unable to organize an effective interception. The battleships in front of them were destroyed by the mechanical army one after another. The two of them charged into the defense line and left, disappearing in the direction of the center of Modo.

The plan that the two of them had discussed was mainly carried out by the two of them, while the rest of the troops stayed at the outer defense line to attack and restrain the enemy. This was because the Modo expeditionary army would definitely set up an encirclement after they entered the center of Modo, and Beyond Grade As were smaller targets and more agile.

…

"What? They've charged in alone?"

In the Modo expeditionary army's base camp, the supreme commander Roddick's expression changed when he heard the frontline report.

He had thought that Black Star would lead the army and charge in with great fanfare, but Han Xiao and Herlous went in alone, which surprised him.

"What's Black Star trying to do? Why did he leave his troops outside? From the looks of it, he doesn't seem like he's trying to take our territory. "Someone was confused.

"He's here to kill. His target is us." Lagos knew what was going on. He sighed and said, "We were the ones who came up with the plan to target Aesop. Black Star probably already knows about it from other sources, so we're all targeted by him."

Hearing this, everyone present could not help but panic.

However, at the same time, they felt strangely flattered. They did not expect that they would one day become the target of a peak Beyond Grade A's assassination mission.

"Could we be wrong? Maybe Black Star has other targets?" Someone could not believe it.

"Don't lie to yourself! He's coming for us! "Roddick yelled angrily.

"Then let's move away from the command center and seek refuge somewhere else!" someone hurriedly said.

"It's useless. Black Star is a Virtual Mechanic. We can't hide from him anywhere."

Roddick's face was pale as he paced back and forth.

He did not regret executing Lagos' plan to target Aesop; he only regretted that it did not succeed. Now, the price of failure had arrived. This was karma.

"Let's ask the upper echelons for help. Since Black Star is so arrogant, we might be able to kill Black Star if the Beyond Grade As cooperate with our expeditionary army," someone carefully suggested.

Hearing this, Roddick and Lagos looked at each other and saw the sadness in each other's eyes.

As the upper echelons of the expeditionary army, the two of them naturally knew what choice the Modo Civilization would make in this situation.

Black Star had already killed his way into the hinterland. Plus, Modo would not expose their Beyond Grade As and risk coming here to save people. In other words, even if the Modo upper echelons knew about Black Star's current goal, they would not be able to help much. They had already been abandoned.

In fact, when Black Star announced that he would personally join the battle, Roddick already knew that the situation was hopeless. He had asked the Modo upper echelons for help more than once, hoping to send Beyond Grade As over to defend. However, the Modo upper echelons never said anything. Instead, they only asked them to hold on and only provide resources and ordinary fleets … How could this level of support stop Black Star!

This is like giving me a budget of 100 Enas but asking me to achieve the effect of 10000 Enas. I can't do it!

What are the upper echelons hesitating for? Is there a need to hide the identity of a direct Beyond Grade A? If not now, when?

Roddick roared in his mind, but no matter what he thought, he could not make the decision for the upper echelons.

"There's only one way left, which is to ask for help from the Supercluster Alliance," Lagos said with a deep voice.

Roddick nodded with a dark expression. He took out his communicator, entered the communication channel of the upper echelons of the Supercluster Alliance expeditionary army, and spoke.

"Guys, I need help. Black Star is attacking …"

He explained the situation, and the channel was silent for a while. Then, another expeditionary army commander from the Supercluster Civilization asked with a deep voice, "What do we do?"

"What do you want us to do?"

"We can't stop Black Star. I hope you can send reinforcements to help us defeat Black Star. We also hope to temporarily move the command center to one of your territories. That way, Black Star won't be able to carry out the decapitation operation …"

"Impossible!" another commander said angrily. "This is something you Modo started. Solve it yourselves!"

Roddick's face darkened. "We agreed to advance and retreat together. Are you going to go back on the agreement just like that?"

"The covenant says that we should deal with the conflicts of the three Universal Civilizations together, not all of us should pay for your own debts!" someone yelled angrily. "To be honest, I've tolerated Modo for a long time!"

The Supercluster Civilization formed the alliance to snatch development territory from the three Universal Civilizations. They had already suppressed a lot of their selfishness and would not continue to fight among themselves at this time.

However, when it came to the overall strategy, the other Supercluster Civilizations had no reason to negotiate. If there was no Beyond Grade A Association, and Black Star was representing the three Universal Civilizations, they would have provided assistance without hesitation.

However, the Beyond Grade As had already formed the association and expressed that they would stay out of this, causing the advantage of the three Universal Civilizations' high-level combatants to disappear. This was supposed to be a good thing, but Modo had provoked Black Star. If the others got involved, who knew what the Beyond Grade A Association's attitude would be? Would Black Star turn around and mess with them? They could not even take care of themselves now. No one wanted to be dragged down by Modo's mess.

Therefore, the other Supercluster Civilizations did not want to help Modo deal with Black Star at all. Otherwise, their overall strategy would be greatly affected. Instead of that, they might as well sacrifice their teammates to the heavens.

Roddick hung up the communicator with a sour expression.

Everyone present heard the conversation just now. The room was shrouded in a gloomy fog.

"Looks like we can only rely on ourselves …"

Lagos said, but he smiled bitterly in his heart. He knew that there was no hope unless a miracle happened.

Thinking of how high-spirited he was when he took office and compared it to how desperate he was now, Lagos had mixed feelings.

If not for the Modo Civilization's scheme against the Kunde Race, they would not have been forced to accept such a mess. Modo could have been like the other Supercluster Civilizations and not fallen into such a predicament.

Although Lagos did not like to push the blame, at this moment, he could not help but hate the guy who suggested to the upper echelons to plot against the Kunde Race.

What a f * cking scammer!
